headline: GROUP ELEVEN BALLYWIRE RETURNS 5.4m AT 20.7% Zn+Pb — AND 7.7m AT 139 g/t Ag in Step-Out; Ireland's Decade-Best Discovery Extends in Four Zones
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Group Eleven Resources
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSX-V: ZNG) reported its latest Ballywire drill results, with hole 26-3552-64 returning 5.4 metres at 20.7% combined zinc-lead and 87 g/t silver within a broader interval of 13.7 metres at 9.1% Zn+Pb and 38 g/t Ag, plus a separate 80-metre step-out cut 7.7 metres at 139 g/t silver and 0.28% copper — expanding the discovery's southwestern extension at PG West, Ireland. The company describes Ballywire as the most significant mineral discovery in Ireland in over a decade, with 86 holes now reported across four mineralised zones; no resource estimate has yet been prepared.

headline: GENESIS-VAULT SCHEME GOES EFFECTIVE TODAY — 99.74% Vote Creates New A$12.6B Australian Gold Major; Vault Shares Suspended, Implementation Nov 26
snippet: Genesis Minerals' (ASX: GMD) scheme of arrangement to acquire Vault Minerals became legally effective November 17 following Supreme Court of Western Australia approval on November 16, with 99.74% of Vault shareholders voting in favour on November 11. Vault shares are suspended from trading with implementation — the actual share exchange and Vault delisting — scheduled for November 26, creating a combined Australian gold major valued at approximately A$12.6 billion with assets concentrated in Western Australia's Leonora and Kalgoorlie goldfields.

headline: 29METALS CLEARS QUEENSLAND HURDLE FOR CAPRICORN COPPER RESTART — Preliminary TSF 3 Approval Granted; Federal Sign-Off and Funding Decision Still Ahead
snippet: Queensland's state environment department issued preliminary approval for the construction of tailings storage facility (TSF 3) and all enabling infrastructure at 29Metals' Capricorn Copper mine — suspended since March 2024 due to water management challenges — with the company stating water levels are no longer an impediment to restart. Federal environmental approval and a Final Investment Decision, to be funded through streaming, royalty or joint-venture proposals, are still required before the restart can proceed; the Restart Definitive Feasibility Study is due by year-end 2026.

headline: LAOS SUSPENDS CHINA-BACKED RARE EARTH MINE AFTER DUAL POND BREACH — Houaphanh Halts Operations; Water Tests Pending, National Inspection Demanded
snippet: Houaphanh provincial authorities issued a suspension notice to Laos-China Northern Rare Earth Development 2 on November 13 after two processing ponds breached at the company's rare earth mining site, with water test results still pending. The Zone 4 provincial environment association welcomed the suspension and called on national authorities to conduct a full inspection — adding to a growing list of environmental incidents at Chinese-operated rare earth projects across Southeast Asia as ex-China REE supply chain scrutiny intensifies globally.

headline: SUPER COPPER MAPS 600m DRILL TARGET AT CASTILLA — Surface Hits 17.7% Cu; Colombian IOCG Play Gets Its First Drill Program
snippet: Super Copper (CSE: CUPR) defined a priority drill target extending at least 600 metres at its Castilla project in Colombia, following surface rock chip samples grading up to 17.7% copper on an iron oxide copper-gold exploration model. First-ever drilling at Castilla is now planned to test the target at depth; the company notes the IOCG exploration model does not in itself confirm an IOCG deposit is present, and the program represents the first systematic drilling in a district that has seen minimal modern exploration.

headline: HOT CHILI WRAPS 45,000m AT LA VERDE — Best Hole Returns 638m AT 0.41% CuEq From Surface; Maiden Resource Work Underway for Chile's Emerging Porphyry
snippet: Hot Chili (ASX: HCH) announced completion of its 13-month, approximately 45,000-metre drill program at the La Verde copper-gold porphyry discovery in Chile's Atacama Region, with the standout result from hole DKD086 returning 638 metres at 0.41% copper equivalent from surface — the widest confirmed mineralised interval at the project to date. Twenty-one final holes have assays due by late December 2026; the program has effectively doubled the known porphyry discovery footprint since drilling began in October 2025, and maiden resource estimate work is now underway.

headline: OCEANAGOLD DIDIPIO DRILLS 66m AT 8.07 g/t AuEq — Mineralization Extends at Depth Below Resource Shell; Year-End Resource Update Targeted
snippet: OceanaGold (TSX/ASX: OGC) reported drill results from its Didipio mine in the Philippines confirming that high-grade mineralization continues at depth below the existing resource model shell, with a standout interval of 66 metres averaging 8.07 g/t gold equivalent — adding resource potential beyond the current mine plan. Year-to-date drilling at Didipio totals 34,562 metres on a US$10 million 2026 exploration budget, and an updated resource estimate is targeted before year-end.

headline: SCOTIA METALS OPTIONED SPODUMENE PLAY IN BRAZIL'S BAHIA — 3.3km Pegmatite Corridor; CSE Junior Joins South America's Emerging Hard-Rock Lithium Belt
snippet: Scotia Metals (CSE: SMET) secured an option to acquire a lithium project in Bahia state, northeastern Brazil, where early-stage exploration has identified suspected spodumene-bearing pegmatites along a 3.3-kilometre corridor — a geometry consistent with hard-rock lithium systems elsewhere in Brazil's Pegmatite Province. No drill results have yet been reported from the project, which sits in a region attracting junior explorer interest as an analog to the prolific Jequitinhonha Valley lithium belt at a time when lithium carbonate prices face bearish near-term forecasts.

headline: CODELCO-ADANI DEAL IS AN OPTION, NOT A SUPPLY LINE — Kaburkaala MoU Has No Resource, No Budget, No Output; India Still Needs 2.7Mt Cu Over 21 Years
snippet: Discovery Alert's analysis cuts through the Codelco-Adani MoU signed during LME Week on November 11 to argue that the agreement for the Kaburkaala copper exploration project in Chile's Antofagasta region is a non-binding option with no disclosed resource, capital budget or output commitment — not the supply security event some headlines implied. With India's Mundra smelter needing approximately 2.7 million tonnes of copper over 21 years to run full, Adani needs an operating mine, not an exploration MoU, and the piece puts the exploration-to-production timeline at 10-plus years under the most optimistic scenario.

headline: MORNING BRIEFING: GOLD AND SILVER HIT 52-WEEK LOWS — But Miners Keep Delivering Drill Results; Bear Market Creating Value Bifurcation
snippet: Mining Stock Daily's Tuesday morning briefing frames the current environment — gold and silver trading at 52-week lows while the sector-wide selloff continues — against a contrarian observation that individual mining companies continue to deliver material drill results the broader market is treating as noise. The piece argues the bear market is producing a widening bifurcation between funded explorers with genuine geological news and those dependent on sector sentiment to maintain their market caps, with the former class increasingly trading at significant discounts to their earlier-year peaks.

headline: 4 FILTERS TO FIND WINNING JUNIOR MINERS IN 2026'S BEAR MARKET — Funded Program, High-Grade Hole, Low-Risk Province, No Warrant Overhang
snippet: Discovery Alert's current framework for identifying outperformers among junior miners in the 2026 bear market distils to four screens: (1) a funded drill program that does not require new equity at current share prices; (2) at least one discovery hole with grades that justify the market cap; (3) a project in an infrastructure-rich, permitting-friendly jurisdiction; and (4) a share structure free of warrant overhang or large undisclosed strategic positions that would suppress any re-rating. The piece argues applying all four filters — not just one or two — separates the genuine discovery stories from GDXJ noise, and identifies the characteristics that consistently attract institutional capital once sector sentiment recovers.
